feeds.title: The Legacy of Home
feeds.description: I am a housewife (for more than 30 years); mother of 5; grandmother of 12; and a retired homeschool teacher. The blog is designed to encourage Mothers to have peace and happiness in a Christian home.

feeds.title: Hungry Enough To Eat Six
feeds.description: I'm Nancy. Browse hundreds of casual, creative, and delicious recipes - apps, dinners, drinks, desserts, and more. Then, stick around for culinary adventures with my New England family on the road!

feeds.title: Frugalwoods Blog
feeds.description: I'm Liz, better known as Mrs. Frugalwoods, and I write about a wide range of topics, including my experiences as a parent, my adventures as a novice homesteader, and the financial decisions that made our life possible.

feeds.title: Blue Roof Designs Blog
feeds.description: Bookbinding blog by Elissa Campbell of Blue Roof Designs. Learn about her work in handmade books. Work includes Journals, photo albums, and guest books handmade using traditional bookbinding techniques.

feeds.title: Cat Cutillo Photography & Video Blog
feeds.description: Cat is an award-winning photojournalist who captures weddings in a colorful documentary style. She is a storyteller at heart. She creates wedding photos and films in an editorial, story-telling fashion.
